    Prepare New Covariates for Addition to a FREM Model

    prepareNewCovariates.Rd

    This function processes lists of continuous and categorical covariates to be added to a FREM model. It handles the re-classification of binary categorical variables, calculates initial estimates for the mean (THETA) and variance (OMEGA), assigns new FREMTYPEs, and creates binarized columns in the FFEM dataset for polytomous categorical covariates.

    Usage

    prepareNewCovariates(
  dfFFEM,
  cstrCatCovsToAdd,
  cstrContCovsToAdd,
  cstrCovsToAddOrder,
  existingCovNames,
  lastFremType,
  iFremTypeIncrease,
  strID,
  overrideExistingCheck,
  bRecodeDichotomous = FALSE,
  allowNon01 = FALSE,
  quiet
)

    Arguments

    dfFFEM

    The FFEM data frame containing covariate information for all subjects. This data frame may be modified by adding new binarized columns.

    cstrCatCovsToAdd

    A character vector of categorical covariate names to add.

    cstrContCovsToAdd

    A character vector of continuous covariate names to add.

    cstrCovsToAddOrder

    An optional character vector specifying the order of processing. If NULL, covariates are processed alphabetically.

    existingCovNames

    A list of existing covariate names (from getCovNames) to prevent adding duplicates.

    lastFremType

    The last (highest) FREMTYPE value currently in use.

    iFremTypeIncrease

    The integer value by which to increment FREMTYPE for each new covariate.

    strID

    The name of the subject identifier column.

    overrideExistingCheck

    A logical flag to allow adding covariates that already exist.

    bRecodeDichotomous

    Logical. If TRUE, dichotomous covariates (e.g., coded 1/2) will be automatically recoded to 0/1, and a new variable (e.g., SEX_1) will be created. If FALSE (the default), dichotomous covariates must be strictly coded as 0/1 in the input data; otherwise, a strict validation error will be thrown.

    allowNon01

    Logical. If TRUE, bypasses strict 0/1 validation and allows dichotomous covariates with non-standard coding (e.g., 1/2) to pass through untouched without being recoded. This provides 100% compatibility with PsN legacy behavior. Defaults to FALSE.

    quiet

    A logical flag to suppress printed messages.

    Value

    A list containing four elements:

    covList

    A list where each element contains the prepared information for a new covariate (Name, Mean, Var, Fremtype, Data).

    addedList

    A character vector of the names of the covariates that were successfully prepared for addition (e.g., c("AGE", "SITE_2", "SITE_3")).

    dfFFEM

    The potentially modified dfFFEM data frame with new binarized columns.

    lastFremType

    The updated last (highest) FREMTYPE value.
